Template Notes
  • The two newest styles (WE ARE HIRING and Multiple Roles) render from full-brand HTML templates, so they take a couple of seconds to build and download — the older three are instant.
  • The WE ARE HIRING panel is a fixed height: it looks best with a full set of requirements and benefits (aim for 4–5 requirements and 4–6 benefits). With only one or two items it will show empty space below the panel.
  • The Multiple Roles style shows a maximum of 6 roles. Extra lines are ignored. 4 to 6 roles looks best.
  • If a new-style download ever comes out in the wrong font, download it once more — the first render occasionally beats the font loading.
  • These two styles need the online renderer. If your connection blocks it, use one of the original three styles.
